# OMA-AI

> Permissionless AI inference gateway. One OpenAI-compatible API for 80+ models
> across Venice and other providers. Pay with crypto (USDC on Base via x402),
> sign in with a wallet, no subscriptions, no email, no prompts logged.

## Overview
- API base URL: `https://api.oma-ai.com/v1` (mirror: `https://api-staging.oma-ai.com/v1`)
- OpenAI-compatible: drop-in for `openai-python`, `openai-node`, Vercel AI SDK,
  LangChain, raw `fetch`, and any HTTP client.
- Free tier: $0.05 in credits on signup, no card required.
- Auth: wallet-based accounts (SIWE), API keys, and per-request x402 payments.

## Documentation
- [Docs home](https://oma-ai.com/docs): full API reference
- [Model catalog](https://oma-ai.com/models): all models, prices, capabilities
- [Pricing](https://oma-ai.com/pricing): per-token cost breakdown
- [Quick start](https://oma-ai.com/docs#quickstart): first request in 5 minutes
- [Error codes](https://oma-ai.com/docs#errors): status codes and retry patterns
- [Privacy manifest (JSON)](https://oma-ai.com/api/v1/privacy): machine-readable privacy policy

## Endpoints
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/v1/chat/completions` | POST | Chat completions (streaming + tool calls) |
| `/v1/models` | GET | List available models and capabilities |
| `/v1/images/generations` | POST | Image generation (Seedream, etc.) |
| `/v1/videos/generations` | POST | Async video generation |
| `/v1/videos/retrieve` | GET | Poll video job status |
| `/v1/x402/quote` | POST | Get x402 payment quote for a request |
| `/v1/x402/deposit` | POST | Create USDC deposit order |
| `/v1/x402/proxy/chat/completions` | POST | Chat completions paid with x402 |
| `/v1/api-keys` | GET/POST/DELETE | Manage API keys |
| `/v1/account/export` | GET | Export all account data |
| `/v1/account/delete` | POST | Delete account and all data |
| `/v1/privacy` | GET | Machine-readable privacy manifest |
| `/v1/health` | GET | Service and upstream provider health |

## Authentication
Three modes, all served by the same endpoints:

1. **API key** — `Authorization: Bearer $OMA_KEY`. Free signup on
   [oma-ai.com](https://oma-ai.com) issues $0.05 in credits to start.
2. **Wallet (SIWE)** — `Authorization: SIWE <base64-payload>`. Wallet-based,
   email-free account identity.
3. **x402 pay-per-request** — `Pay-Req:` header with an EIP-3009 signed
   USDC quote. No account required. Used by AI agents that auto-pay each
   request from their own on-chain balance.

## Pricing model
Per-token prices in `server/models.json` are a **25% markup over Venice's cost**.
The catalog JSON is the source of truth for both the displayed user price
(`inputPricePer1M`, `outputPricePer1M`) and the internal credit conversion
(`creditsPerMillionInput` = `inputPricePer1M * 125`).

Direct passthrough pricing rules:
- `/v1/chat/completions`: 25% markup over Venice's USD list price.
- `/v1/x402/proxy/*`: 25% markup over Venice, paid per-request with USDC on Base.
- `/v1/images/generations` and `/v1/videos/generations`: flat-fee per generation
  in credits; markups vary per model.

A full per-model breakdown is at [/v1/models](https://oma-ai.com/api/v1/models).

## Privacy
OMA stores only what it must to bill and authenticate you. **Prompts and
completions are never stored.** See the JSON policy at
[/v1/privacy](https://oma-ai.com/api/v1/privacy).

Data we keep:
- Wallet address (account identifier), nonce, optional email
- API key hashes (plaintext is shown to the user once and discarded)
- Credit balance and deposit history
- Per-request billing record: model, tokens, cost, latency — **never the prompt or completion**

Data we never keep:
- Raw chat prompts or completions (forwarded to upstream; not logged)
- Upstream provider API keys (you supply OMA-issued keys only)
- Credit card numbers (handled by third-party onramps)
- Long-term IP logs (request IP is held only for the duration of the request)

We do not train models on your data. We do not sell your data. GDPR and CCPA
rights are honored via `/v1/account/export` and `/v1/account/delete`.
